features.hero.title: Everything your money needs. *In one app.*
features.hero.lead: Dinars, dollars and digital dollars in one account. Pay by @handle, send home, trade with escrow and save toward goals — every capability is below, each marked with where it stands today.
features.hero.note: Coming to iPhone and Android. Pre-launch: services depend on regulatory approval and partner availability.
features.hero.alt: The tazdan home screen: total balance, quick actions and recent activity
features.index.label: On this page
features.switcher.label: Screens in this section
features.accounts.pain: Dinars in one bank, dollars kept at home, crypto in an app you don’t quite trust.
features.accounts.title: Every currency. *One place.*
features.accounts.lead: Hold Libyan dinars, US dollars, euros and more beside USDT and other digital assets — each in its own wallet, each valued at the live rate, with every movement on record.
features.accounts.alt.onboarding: The tazdan welcome screens before sign-up
features.accounts.alt.balances: Swipeable balance pages showing the total and each currency
features.accounts.alt.wallet: The wallet tab listing fiat and crypto holdings
features.accounts.alt.asset: An asset detail screen with a live price chart
features.accounts.alt.portfolio: The crypto portfolio view with holdings and allocation
features.accounts.cap.signup.title: Open an account in minutes
features.accounts.cap.signup.body: Your name, email, phone number, a strong password and your own @handle. You must be 18 or over.
features.accounts.cap.email.title: Email verification and password reset
features.accounts.cap.email.body: A 6-digit code confirms your email, and the same kind of code resets a forgotten password.
features.accounts.cap.phone.title: Phone number verification
features.accounts.cap.phone.body: A code by SMS or WhatsApp. It switches on once the messaging provider is connected.
features.accounts.cap.apple.title: Sign in with Apple
features.accounts.cap.apple.body: Shown in the app as coming soon. Email and password work today.
features.accounts.cap.fiat.title: Wallets for every currency you use
features.accounts.cap.fiat.body: LYD, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR and EGP, each in its own wallet.
features.accounts.cap.crypto.title: USDT and other digital assets
features.accounts.cap.crypto.body: USDT — digital dollars — plus BTC, ETH, SOL and other supported assets, held next to your cash.
features.accounts.cap.pages.title: Swipeable balance pages
features.accounts.cap.pages.body: Your total first, then each currency in its own money with its live rate, then your crypto on one page.
features.accounts.cap.display.title: Your display currency
features.accounts.cap.display.body: Choose the currency your totals are shown in.
features.accounts.cap.asset.title: Asset detail with a live chart
features.accounts.cap.asset.body: Price, change and a chart from the last hour to all time, for every asset you can hold.
features.accounts.cap.portfolio.title: Portfolio views
features.accounts.cap.portfolio.body: See your cash allocation and your crypto holdings, each on its own page.
features.accounts.cap.wallet.title: A calm wallet view
features.accounts.cap.wallet.body: Filter by fiat, crypto or cards. Empty wallets fold away, so the list stays about the money you hold.
features.accounts.cap.delete.title: Close your account yourself
features.accounts.cap.delete.body: Delete your account in the app. It shows exactly what needs settling first, such as a balance or an open trade.
features.move.pain: To get paid, you hand a stranger your IBAN and phone number — then wait for the bank.
features.move.title: Pay anyone by *@handle.*
features.move.lead: Money between tazdan users moves instantly, by @handle or from your contacts. Nobody needs your bank details — and someone who isn’t on tazdan yet can still receive with a claim link.
features.move.alt.send: Sending money to a @handle in tazdan
features.move.alt.confirm: The review screen before a transfer, with slide to confirm
features.move.alt.receive: The receive screen with a QR code and @handle
features.move.alt.claim: A claim link ready to share with someone not on tazdan
features.move.alt.topup: Top up by bank transfer with a payment reference
features.move.alt.withdraw: Withdrawing to a bank account or a crypto address
features.move.cap.handle.title: Send by @handle, email or phone
features.move.cap.handle.body: Find anyone on tazdan and pay them. Transfers between tazdan users are instant.
features.move.cap.review.title: Review, then slide to confirm
features.move.cap.review.body: See the recipient, the amount and any fee before anything moves. A slide confirms it.
features.move.cap.receive.title: Receive with a QR code or your handle
features.move.cap.receive.body: Show your QR code, copy your profile link or share your @handle — whoever has it can pay you.
features.move.cap.scan.title: Built-in QR scanner
features.move.cap.scan.body: Scan a tazdan QR code to pay someone or open a claim link.
features.move.cap.claim.title: Claim links for people not on tazdan
features.move.cap.claim.body: Send by link, email or phone. The money is reserved for them, an optional PIN protects it, and they claim it — signing up first if they need to.
features.move.cap.claimSafe.title: Links that can’t be claimed twice
features.move.cap.claimSafe.body: Cancel an unclaimed link at any time and the money comes straight back. A link that expires returns the money to you.
features.move.cap.topupBank.title: Top up by bank transfer
features.move.cap.topupBank.body: Transfer to a tazdan bank account with your reference. Our team confirms the payment, then your wallet is credited.
features.move.cap.topupCrypto.title: Receive crypto at your own address
features.move.cap.topupCrypto.body: Each supported asset has a deposit address and network, with a clear warning to send only the matching asset.
features.move.cap.topupCard.title: Top up by card
features.move.cap.topupCard.body: Card and payment-gateway top-ups wait on a payment partner.
features.move.cap.topupAgent.title: Cash top-up through local agents
features.move.cap.topupAgent.body: Pay cash to an agent and get dinars credited. Built into the app, waiting for an agent network.
features.move.cap.withdrawBank.title: Withdraw to your bank
features.move.cap.withdrawBank.body: Save your bank accounts and request a payout. Every bank payout is approved by our team.
features.move.cap.withdrawChain.title: Withdraw on-chain
features.move.cap.withdrawChain.body: Send BTC, ETH, SOL or USDT to an external address, after sanctions screening and with your two-factor code.
features.abroad.pain: Sending to family abroad means a middleman, a week of waiting and a rate you only learn afterwards.
features.abroad.title: Send home what they’re *actually owed.*
features.abroad.lead: Twelve routes between Libya and the places Libyans live, study and trade. You see the fee, the exchange rate and exactly what arrives before you confirm.
features.abroad.note: Pilot: every route runs on test rails until a licensed payout partner is live for it. In test mode no real money leaves tazdan.
features.abroad.alt.home: The send abroad screen with recent international transfers
features.abroad.alt.quote: A locked quote showing the fee, the rate and what the recipient gets
features.abroad.alt.track: A transfer timeline from created to delivered
features.abroad.cap.corridors.title: 12 routes, in both directions
features.abroad.cap.corridors.body: Libya to and from the United Kingdom, the euro area, Egypt, Turkey, the UAE and Tunisia.
features.abroad.cap.payout.title: Bank, mobile wallet, cash pickup or tazdan
features.abroad.cap.payout.body: Payout options depend on the route — for example mobile wallets in Egypt, or cash pickup on a route into Libya.
features.abroad.cap.recipients.title: Saved recipients
features.abroad.cap.recipients.body: Add someone once, with their relationship to you, and choose them next time.
features.abroad.cap.quote.title: A locked quote
features.abroad.cap.quote.body: The rate is held for a few minutes. If it runs out, you see the new price before anything is sent.
features.abroad.cap.checks.title: Purpose and source of funds
features.abroad.cap.checks.body: Every transfer states its purpose. Larger amounts also ask where the money comes from, as the rules require.
features.abroad.cap.confirm.title: Confirm with Face ID
features.abroad.cap.confirm.body: High-value or new-device transfers are confirmed with biometrics and, if asked, a 6-digit code.
features.abroad.cap.track.title: A tracking timeline
features.abroad.cap.track.body: Created, paid from your wallet, sent to the payout partner, delivered — each step with its time.
features.abroad.cap.refund.title: Cancel and get a full refund
features.abroad.cap.refund.body: If the money hasn’t been paid out yet, cancelling returns it to your wallet in full.
features.exchange.pain: Two dollar rates — and you always seem to get the worse one.
features.exchange.title: Change money at *the real rate.*
features.exchange.lead: Convert between your own wallets, or buy and sell USDT and other digital assets. Your quote is held while you review it, so the amount you confirm is the amount you get.
features.exchange.alt.convert: Converting between two of your wallets at a live rate
features.exchange.alt.buy: Buying USDT with every fee shown before you confirm
features.exchange.alt.sell: Selling a digital asset into a wallet you choose
features.exchange.alt.recurring: Setting up a recurring buy with a schedule
features.exchange.cap.convert.title: Convert between your wallets
features.exchange.cap.convert.body: Move value between dinars, dollars and your other currencies at live rates. A conversion never fills below the amount you were shown.
features.exchange.cap.buy.title: Buy USDT and digital assets
features.exchange.cap.buy.body: Pay from a fiat wallet or your crypto balance, see every fee, then slide to buy.
features.exchange.cap.sell.title: Sell back to cash
features.exchange.cap.sell.body: Sell what you hold and choose the wallet that receives the money.
features.exchange.cap.held.title: Quotes held while you review
features.exchange.cap.held.body: If a quote expires before you confirm, you get a fresh price instead of a surprise.
features.exchange.cap.recurring.title: Recurring buy
features.exchange.cap.recurring.body: Buy automatically — daily, weekly, every two weeks or monthly — from a fiat wallet. Pause or cancel at any time.
features.exchange.cap.recurringCard.body: Funding a schedule from a card waits on the card partner.
features.p2p.pain: Meeting a stranger with a bag of cash — and hoping the dollars arrive afterwards.
features.p2p.title: Trade person to person, *with escrow.*
features.p2p.lead: Buy or sell USDT and other assets with people near you or anywhere in the country. The crypto waits in escrow until the seller confirms they were paid — and if something goes wrong, a tazdan agent steps in.
features.p2p.alt.market: The P2P marketplace with offers from sellers
features.p2p.alt.near: Traders near you, shown with a rounded distance only
features.p2p.alt.trade: An active P2P trade with escrow and a payment countdown
features.p2p.cap.market.title: A marketplace of offers
features.p2p.cap.market.body: The Buy tab shows people selling; the Sell tab shows people buying. Filter by asset and currency.
features.p2p.cap.escrow.title: Escrow on every trade
features.p2p.cap.escrow.body: The seller’s crypto is locked when the trade starts and released only when they confirm your payment.
features.p2p.cap.methods.title: Pay the way you agree
features.p2p.cap.methods.body: Bank transfer, cash in person or your tazdan wallet — each offer lists what it accepts.
features.p2p.cap.listing.title: Post your own offer
features.p2p.cap.listing.body: Set your price, limits, payment methods and terms for USDT, BTC, ETH or SOL, against LYD, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR or EGP.
features.p2p.cap.near.title: Near me
features.p2p.cap.near.body: Opt in to see traders close by. Your area is rounded to about a kilometre and never shown — others see only a rough distance.
features.p2p.cap.reputation.title: A real track record
features.p2p.cap.reputation.body: Traders appear by first name and last initial, with their completed trades, completion rate and a verified badge.
features.p2p.cap.chat.title: Trade chat with payment proof
features.p2p.cap.chat.body: Talk to the other side inside the trade and attach a photo of your transfer receipt.
features.p2p.cap.timer.title: A clear payment window
features.p2p.cap.timer.body: Every trade shows a countdown, so both sides know how long payment can take.
features.p2p.cap.dispute.title: Disputes reviewed by a person
features.p2p.cap.dispute.body: Open a dispute from the trade and a tazdan agent joins to review it.
features.p2p.cap.safety.title: Safety prompts for cash meetings
features.p2p.cap.safety.body: For cash trades, the app reminds you to meet somewhere busy and to confirm only after you’ve counted.
features.p2p.cap.tracker.title: All your trades in one list
features.p2p.cap.tracker.body: Active, completed and everything else — with what’s in escrow right now.
features.save.pain: Money set aside for something important has a way of disappearing — and there’s no simple tool to keep it put.
features.save.title: Goals that *fill themselves.*
features.save.lead: Name a goal, choose a currency and a target date, and let tazdan set money aside on a schedule. Lock it if you want it to stay where it is.
features.save.alt.detail: One savings goal with its lock and automatic contributions
features.save.alt.new: Creating a savings goal with a schedule and a lock
features.save.cap.goals.title: Savings goals with progress
features.save.cap.goals.body: Each goal has a name, an emoji, a currency, an optional target and a progress ring.
features.save.cap.auto.title: Automatic contributions
features.save.cap.auto.body: Add a set amount daily, weekly, every two weeks or monthly.
features.save.cap.plan.title: A plan that does the maths
features.save.cap.plan.body: Give it a target and a date and it suggests how much to save each time — or shows when you’ll get there.
features.save.cap.lock.title: Lock until a date, a code, or both
features.save.cap.lock.body: A locked goal can’t be emptied on impulse: withdrawals wait for the unlock date, a confirmation code, or both.
features.save.cap.move.title: Add, withdraw or close
features.save.cap.move.body: Add to a goal at any time and take money out whenever the lock allows.
features.save.cap.card.title: Spend a goal on your card
features.save.cap.card.body: Loading a goal onto a card arrives with tazdan cards.
features.messages.pain: “Send me your account number” — then screenshots of receipts across three different apps.
features.messages.title: Money, *in the conversation.*
features.messages.lead: Chat with the people you know, settle up inside the thread, and keep every payment between you in one place.
features.messages.alt.inbox: The messages inbox with conversations and filters
features.messages.alt.payment: A conversation with a payment bubble and its receipt
features.messages.alt.contact: A contact page with the payments between you
features.messages.cap.chats.title: Chats with anyone on tazdan
features.messages.cap.chats.body: Search your conversations and filter by unread, payments or support.
features.messages.cap.pay.title: Payments inside the chat
features.messages.cap.pay.body: Send money from the thread. It appears as a payment bubble with its receipt.
features.messages.cap.request.title: Request money
features.messages.cap.request.body: Ask for an amount with a reason, and they can pay it from the same chat.
features.messages.cap.contacts.title: Contacts with your shared history
features.messages.cap.contacts.body: Everyone you’ve paid or been paid by, with the totals between you and every payment.
features.messages.cap.privacy.title: Read receipts and last seen, on your terms
features.messages.cap.privacy.body: Both are mutual: switch one off and neither of you sees it.
features.messages.cap.tools.title: Edit, delete, pin and stickers
features.messages.cap.tools.body: Edit or delete your messages, pin the chats that matter and reply with a sticker.
features.messages.cap.safety.title: Block and report
features.messages.cap.safety.body: Block someone, report a message, or bring support into a conversation.
features.messages.cap.support.title: Support in the same inbox
features.messages.cap.support.body: Message the tazdan team from your chats whenever you need help.
features.cards.pain: Foreign cards that get declined, and online payments that never go through.
features.cards.title: A card for *everyday spending.*
features.cards.lead: Virtual and physical cards are designed and built into the app. They switch on with a card-issuing partner — until then, cards are not available.
features.cards.note: Planned: cards need a licensed card-issuing partner. We will say so here the day they go live.
features.cards.alt.cards: The cards screen as designed in the app
features.cards.cap.virtual.title: Virtual card
features.cards.cap.virtual.body: Issue a card in the app for online spending.
features.cards.cap.physical.title: Physical card
features.cards.cap.physical.body: Order a card to your address and follow it from printing to delivery.
features.cards.cap.controls.title: Freeze and PIN
features.cards.cap.controls.body: Freeze or unfreeze a card in a tap, and view your PIN securely.
features.cards.cap.topup.title: Top up and track spending
features.cards.cap.topup.body: Load money onto a card and see your recent spending.
features.cards.cap.wallet.title: Add to your phone’s wallet
features.cards.cap.wallet.body: Pay with your phone where it’s supported.
features.security.pain: Your phone number, your name and your bank details — handed to everyone you pay.
features.security.title: Your details *stay yours.*
features.security.lead: We verify who you are once, so nobody else needs to know. Pay by handle, hide your balances, and confirm the moves that matter with a second step.
features.security.alt.kyc: The verification screen with your level and the next step
features.security.alt.limits: Your limits per action, with what’s left and when it resets
features.security.alt.stepup: A 6-digit confirmation for a high-value payment
features.security.alt.twofa: Setting up two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app
features.security.cap.kyc.title: Identity verification in levels
features.security.cap.kyc.body: Level 1: an ID and a selfie. Level 2: proof of address. Level 3: source of funds. Documents are encrypted and used only to verify you.
features.security.cap.limits.title: Live limits, shown before you confirm
features.security.cap.limits.body: See what’s left to buy, sell, send or withdraw, when it resets and what the next level unlocks — the app tells you before you reach a limit, not after.
features.security.cap.stepup.title: A second step for big or unusual moves
features.security.cap.stepup.body: High-value payments or a new device ask for a 6-digit code by email or authenticator app, or biometrics on a trusted device.
features.security.cap.twofa.title: Two-factor sign-in
features.security.cap.twofa.body: Use an authenticator app. Turning it off needs both a code and your password, and a lost authenticator can be recovered with an emailed code.
features.security.cap.biometric.title: Face ID on trusted devices
features.security.cap.biometric.body: Sign back in with biometrics on a device you’ve already verified.
features.security.cap.devices.title: Trusted devices and sessions
features.security.cap.devices.body: See every device and session, forget a device or sign out the others — it takes effect straight away.
features.security.cap.privacy.title: Privacy mode
features.security.cap.privacy.body: Hide balances everywhere with one tap, and hold a figure to peek. Market prices stay visible.
features.security.cap.handle.title: No bank details to hand out
features.security.cap.handle.body: People pay your @handle or a claim link — they never need your IBAN or phone number.
features.security.cap.visibility.title: Choose who can find you
features.security.cap.visibility.body: Make your profile public so people can find your @handle, or keep it private.
features.security.cap.p2p.title: Private in P2P
features.security.cap.p2p.body: Traders see your first name and last initial. Near me shares only a rough distance — never your location.
features.security.cap.screening.title: Checks on money leaving
features.security.cap.screening.body: Withdrawals and transfers pass sanctions screening and a risk check before they go.
features.extras.pain: A bank statement means a trip to the branch — if they have paper that day.
features.extras.title: The details, *done properly.*
features.extras.lead: Statements you can download, a history that explains itself, notifications you control — and an app that speaks your language.
features.extras.alt.statements: Generating a PDF statement for a chosen period
features.extras.alt.history: The full activity history with references and statuses
features.extras.alt.notifications: The notifications inbox grouped by day
features.extras.alt.linked: Linked bank accounts with a default for withdrawals
features.extras.alt.handle: A public profile opened from a tazdan profile link
features.extras.alt.settings: Settings for theme, language, notifications and security
features.extras.alt.referrals: Your referral code, ready to share
features.extras.cap.history.title: Full activity history
features.extras.cap.history.body: Every transaction with its time, reference or hash, and status — plus your pending claim links.
features.extras.cap.statements.title: Downloadable statements
features.extras.cap.statements.body: PDF statements for a month, a year or all time, for one currency or all of them — balances, fees and the full ledger.
features.extras.cap.notifications.title: Notifications inbox
features.extras.cap.notifications.body: Activity on your account and announcements, grouped by day.
features.extras.cap.notifPrefs.title: Notification settings
features.extras.cap.notifPrefs.body: Choose email or push for trades, transfers, deposits, withdrawals, P2P and offers. Security messages always reach you.
features.extras.cap.linked.title: Linked accounts
features.extras.cap.linked.body: Keep your bank accounts saved for withdrawals and choose a default.
features.extras.cap.handle.title: Your profile link
features.extras.cap.handle.body: tazdan.com/u/yourhandle opens your profile in the app — photo, bio, P2P record and a Send button.
features.extras.cap.referral.title: Invite friends
features.extras.cap.referral.body: Share your personal referral code or link.
features.extras.cap.themes.title: Dark, light or mono
features.extras.cap.themes.body: Three themes, including a calm monochrome mode.
features.extras.cap.language.title: Arabic first
features.extras.cap.language.body: The app opens in Arabic and switches to English or another language in a tap.
features.extras.cap.tour.title: A guided tour
features.extras.cap.tour.body: Replay the in-app tour from your profile whenever you like.
features.extras.cap.feel.title: Haptics and sounds
features.extras.cap.feel.body: Gentle feedback when money moves, so you know it landed.
features.business.pain: Paying staff and suppliers one bank transfer at a time — or in cash envelopes.
features.business.title: Running a business? *There’s tazdan Business.*
features.business.lead: The same app, with a business profile, a team, bulk payouts with a second approver, and an API for your own systems.
features.business.alt.bulk: Previewing a bulk payout before approval
features.business.cap.kyb.title: Business profile and KYB
features.business.cap.kyb.body: Submit your business for verification and follow the review.
features.business.cap.team.title: Team and roles
features.business.cap.team.body: Invite people as owner, admin, analyst or developer, and change roles at any time.
features.business.cap.bulk.title: Bulk pay
features.business.cap.bulk.body: Pay many tazdan customers in one batch: preview it, reserve the funds, and have a second owner or admin approve above a threshold.
features.business.cap.payouts.title: Payout history
features.business.cap.payouts.body: Filter payouts by status, open the detail, cancel a pending one, and approve or reject batches.
features.business.cap.keys.title: API keys
features.business.cap.keys.body: Scoped, expiring keys, shown once and stored only as hashes. A key can never do more than the person who made it.
features.business.cap.api.title: Public API
features.business.cap.api.body: Balances, rates, payouts and webhooks, with idempotency keys so a retry never pays twice.
features.business.cap.webhooks.title: Signed webhooks
features.business.cap.webhooks.body: Every event is signed, retried on failure and delivered only over HTTPS.
features.all.title: Every capability, *in one list.*
features.all.lead: This is the whole app as it stands in the current build. Each line says plainly where it is: in the app, in pilot, or planned.
features.all.legend.label: What the labels mean
features.all.legend.inApp: Built and working in the current app build.
features.all.legend.pilot: Complete, running on test rails until a licensed partner is live.
features.all.legend.planned: Designed, and waiting on a partner before it switches on.
features.all.note: Availability depends on your country and verification level. Pilot and planned capabilities are not live services.
